readout_other: Fugl-Meyer Assessment; Nottingham Sensory Assessment; Modified Barthel Index; Berg Balance Scale; Box and Block; ARAT; finger grip
direction_notes: Both patients improved on FMA upper extremity, kinaesthetic sensation, stereognosis and MBI after contralesional M1 stimulation intended to be inhibitory; single-group pilot with no control.
safety_notes: Adverse event evaluations (stroke exacerbation, seizure, headache, neurological symptoms) at each session and at 3 weeks; no adverse event in either participant.

exposures.label: tFUS to contralesional M1 hand knob

target.label: central sulcus 'knob' area within the primary motor cortex (M1) contralateral to the lesion site

timing.protocol_description: Treatment given three times a week; total treatment duration 1200 seconds without a sonication interval (20 minutes).

source_quotes.n_subjects: This study was a single-group prospective pilot study with two stroke patients.
